title: Warplane with Targets and CDs
description: Mixed-media collage combining drawn warplane silhouette, cloud outlines, and concentric target rings with physical compact discs, a light bulb, silver foil, and a neon-yellow plastic panel. Red vertical stripes frame the composition, and text reading 'BROWN' appears along a crumpled foil band at center-bottom.
composition: vertical cross axis anchors layered mixed-media zones
